## Let's make some fun functions! 

```{r}
## Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(fishualize)
```

## First, we make a dataframe with random data for fish length (in centimeters) for three pelagic species in Hawaiʻi
```{r}
fishlengths <- tibble(
  ahi = runif(10,min=60,max=150),
  ono = runif(10,min=100,max=165),
  aku = runif(10,min=30,max=90))        # Set a dataframe with random numbers for fish lengths between average cm for three pelagic species in Hawaiʻi
head(fishlengths)                       # View the data
```

## Then, we create a function to convert the lengths from centimeters to millimeters (in case any fisher **really** wanted to exaggerate how big their catch was)
```{r}
cm_to_mm <- function(x){x*10}     # Create the function
cm_to_mm(5)                       # Test the function
```
## Now, we'll apply our function across the dataframe to make all the fishes seem bigger
```{r}
fishes_mm <- fishlengths |>
  mutate(across(everything(),cm_to_mm))  # Use mutate to apply the function across the entire dataframe
head(fishes_mm)                          # View the data to see if it worked
```

## Next, let's make a simple plot function for the average fish data from the tibble in centimeters.
```{r}
## Make the dataframe usable for a function
avelengths <- fishlengths |>                  # Pivot the tibble to be able to plot the dataframe
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "length_cm"
  ) |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(mean_length = mean(length_cm))    # Calculate the average length of each species based on the tibble
head(avelengths)                              # View the data
```

```{r}
## Create the function with flexible arguments
fishplot <- function(data,x,y){
  ggplot(data,aes(x={{x}},y={{y}},fill=species)) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(title = "Average Length of 3 Pelagic Fishes in Hawaiʻi",
         x = "Species", y = "Average Fork Length (cm)") +
    scale_fill_fish_d(option="Variola_louti") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position="none")
}
```

```{r}
## Test the function with the dataframe
fishplot(data=avelengths,x=species,y=mean_length)
ggsave(here("Week_08","Outputs","Pelagic_Fishes_Fork_Lengths.png"))
```
